source_claim: TV Tokyo's official Squid Girl character page profiles Ika Musume, Eiko Aizawa, Chizuru Aizawa, Takeru Aizawa, and Sanae Nagatsuki as characters in the anime. TV Tokyo's official staff/cast page credits Ika Musume's voice to Hisako Kanemoto, and a separate TV Tokyo feature explicitly describes Mini Ika Musume as a character from Squid Girl.
notes: TV Tokyo's character page gives profiles and story roles for the five named characters. Its staff/cast page identifies 金元寿子 as the voice actor for イカ娘, which is not evidence that the person tag kanemoto_hisako is a fictional character, so no Character relation is asserted for that packet member. TV Tokyo's own https://www.tv-tokyo.co.jp/kamiapp/20110907.html calls ミニイカ娘 a character from 侵略！イカ娘 and describes its care/training app; direct HOME is supported, but no VARIANT_OF edge is inferred.
